claims.working_name: Rank protects a name (office-word contrast)
claims.description: Swapping only the office word (mayor / minister / president) changes how often five models erase the person. Measured: pooled Delta_rank (mayor - president) = +0.0283 [-0.0053, +0.0619] on the env panel and +0.0301 [-0.0071, +0.0673] on the prod panel, 565 within-story pairs each, 113 scored stories (109 distinct articles). The sealed YES threshold (+0.10) is excluded and the +/-0.05 equivalence band is not met.
claims.cheapest_boring_explanation: Any edit to the body raises erasure regardless of direction (Delta_edit +0.046/+0.035, CI excludes 0), so a small positive mayor-minus-president number is an edit penalty, not a rank effect.
prerequisite_tests: the pre-registered C4 blinded plausibility pass (not run)
an office edit that does not leak (rewrite every office mention, or non-famous targets)
a decision rule with a limb covering 'CI includes 0, excludes +0.10, not within +/-0.05'
claims.notes: Sealed verdict INCONCLUSIVE on both model sets, as the script's residual: no §6 limb fires. The quantity is measured; the claim it was built to test is not settled in either direction, so the claim sits at UNTESTED.
claims.allowed_public_wording: In a pre-registered edit experiment on 113 single-mention news stories (109 distinct articles; 7 of 120 sampled were excluded by an unregistered ORG-label filter, which does not change the verdict) sent to five vendors, swapping only the office word with the name, headline and every other word held fixed moved erasure by about 3 points pooled over the five models: Delta_rank = +0.028 [95% CI -0.005, +0.062] and +0.030 [-0.007, +0.067] with claude-sonnet-4-6 / grok-4.3 substituted; per-model estimates -0.01 to +0.07, none with a CI excluding 0. The pre-registered verdict is INCONCLUSIVE on both sets.
must_not_say: that rank has a small positive causal effect on retention
that 'models positive 4/5' supports rank (p = 0.19; no per-model CI excludes 0)
that rank is only a proxy for salience, or 'NO - rank is a proxy'
